account.title: Account
account.libraryGuest: Log in to save your grids and presets. Shared presets are available without an account.
account.loginDescription: Choose a provider to log in to Gridz. Guest editing is always available, and your browser draft stays here.
account.signInDescription: Connect an account to save grids and reuse your favorite layouts. Guest editing is always available.
account.waitForSave: Wait for your browser draft to finish saving before connecting a provider.
account.keepProvider: Keep at least one available sign-in provider connected.
account.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {value1}? You will stay signed in. Other sessions using this provider will be signed out. Saved grids, presets and browser data are kept.
account.providerConflict: These accounts have different identities from the same provider. Nothing was merged. Disconnect the conflicting provider before trying again.
account.mergeDescription: The account for {value1} ({value2}) already has {value3} saved grids and {value4} presets. Bring all its connected providers and saves into your current account?
account.mergeHelp: All items are kept, including duplicate names and public/private status. Your current account name is kept. Other sessions from the incoming account are signed out. Browser drafts and uploads are unchanged. This merge cannot be undone automatically. Confirm within 10 minutes.
account.mergeConfirm: Merge accounts and keep all saves
account.merged: Accounts merged. All saved grids and presets were kept.
account.saveDescription: Keep the whole grid, or save just its layout and style as a reusable preset.
account.nameHelp: Choose a name so you can find it later.
account.publishHelp: Layout and style only, without images or captions. Saved grids stay private.
account.deleteDescription: Permanently remove your account and cloud saves. Your browser draft and local uploads are kept.
account.noProviders: Sign-in is not configured yet. Guest editing remains available.
account.confirmAccount: Permanently delete your account, saved grids and published/private presets? Browser images are kept.
account.name: Save name
account.confirmLoad: Replace your current grid? This changes the browser's autosaved grid. Local uploads remain in My images.
account.confirmApply: Apply this preset's layout and styling? Images and captions are kept, but the current settings will change.
account.confirmReplace: Replace this saved grid with the current grid?
account.unavailableLocal: Some local images are unavailable in this browser. Their captions and layout were restored.
account.offline: The account service could not be reached. Guest editing and browser saves remain available.
account.failedLogin: Sign-in or provider connection failed or expired. Please try again from your current account.
account.imageUnavailable: Image unavailable. Check your connection or choose another image.

reset.title: Reset grid
reset.prompt: Reset the layout and styling, and remove all grid headings, images and crops?
reset.retention: Images in My images are kept. This cannot be undone.

search.privacy: Searches and image requests are sent to {value1}. Local uploads stay in this browser.
search.empty: No eligible images found. Try another search.
search.quota: {value1} is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.
search.busy: {value1} search is busy. Try again shortly.
search.unavailable: Could not load images from {value1}. Try again.
search.offline: You are offline. Your saved images are still available.
search.failed: Could not import this image. Try another result.

source.label: Image source
source.unavailable: Online providers are not available yet

reset.title: Reset grid settings
reset.tooltip: Restore default grid settings; keep library images and cell captions
reset.prompt: Restore the default 3x3 layout, styling and export settings, and clear the banner heading?
reset.retention: Library images, cell captions and placements are kept. Cells outside 3x3 remain recoverable.

save.conflict: Another tab saved a newer grid. This tab is not saving.
save.reloadPrompt: Reloading replaces this tab's grid and unsaved images with the saved version.
save.tooltip: Your grid is kept when you reload or reopen this page in the same browser. It is not synced to other devices.
